description:

If you've found a new favorite I encourage you to get a copy of your own, either through purchase or from the library, to read with your favorite people again and again! Bookroot Readings suggested questions to help dive into this book. 

1. How long does it take for a chick to develop from being laid by its mother hen to hatching? (0:38) 

2. Once an egg is fertilized and laid, what must happen for that egg to develop into a healthy hatching chick? (1:42)

4. Can an egg from the grocery store be hatched? Why or why not? 

5. When you crack an egg, can you name the parts seen?
